descriptionChirho: To engage in work or labor, often for a livelihood or as productive activity; the basic sense of exerting effort in a task or occupation.
To do or perform actions or deeds, often with moral or ethical connotation (doing good or evil); to carry out, accomplish, or commit.
To produce or bring about an effect or result; to cause something to come into being through action or process.
To work with something in a commercial sense; to trade or do business, as in putting money or resources to productive use.
Passive sense: to have been done, performed, or accomplished; describing deeds or works that have been carried out.
